name: app-template
description: Template for standalone AI applications: Directus + Postgres backend (apps/directus) and a Next + MUI frontend (apps/front). Not an npm workspace — each app installs and builds independently. This root package owns the shared pre-commit tooling (husky + lint-staged + prettier) and the docker-compose shortcuts.

scripts.test: npm test --prefix apps/directus && npm test --prefix apps/front
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix apps/directus && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/front
